definition.title: Capture brand and design
definition.description: Inspect your website and optional repository once. Propose a concise brand guide for future marketing and document the product design you have today. Review both before using them; existing documents stay unchanged.

human_review.reason: Approval makes both documents active guidance for future work.
human_review.summary: Read both proposed documents. Approval applies them together to brand/BRAND.md and DESIGN.md.
human_review.queue_clause: Brand and design ready to use

product_url.title: Product URL
product_url.description: Your public HTTPS website. Optional if a source packet or selected repository provides enough evidence.

notes.title: What should stay?
notes.description: Colors, fonts, references or other choices you want to keep. Existing documents are always carried forward unchanged.

intent.title: Direction
intent.description: Capture records the existing identity. Develop permits modest supporting guidance for new marketing assets, within your notes. Neither changes your site.

include_repository.title: Use connected repository
include_repository.description: Read the selected GitHub repository when available. No source changes or pull request.

source_path.title: Reference packet (optional)
source_path.description: A Markdown path in project Files with attributed observations, links or an existing guide. No credentials or transcripts.
